description.narrative: Nearly 122,000 people benefited from comprehensive and predictable water and sanitation services in three camps. Major water network infrastructure was completed in Azraq and Rukban, ensuring safer, predictable, sustainable and cost-effective delivery of water for more than 86,000 people. Water was delivered to 50,000 asylum seekers in Rukban. | Status:On-track | As-of Date:15/01/2018
